captions.instagram:
IKEA PAX either side of a chimney breast, with an MDF bridge over the fireplace and one run of doors across the whole wall. Palmers Green, London.

The boxes over the frames were glued and clamped on a bench in the room. The face frames, top boxes and doors line up across the wall, so it reads as one piece and the fireplace stays on show.

My 22-page guide, IKEA PAX, built in, has the sums, the cut list and every step. Link in bio.
